_about: Public-domain William James Dawson (1854-1928), Wesleyan and then Congregational minister in London, later an American evangelist, for the Word Hoard: The Threshold of Manhood, The Church of To-morrow, The Endless Choice, The Life of Christ, The Reproach of Christ, The Evangelistic Note, The Forgotten Secret, The Empire of Love, The Divine Challenge, The Book of Courage, and The Man Christ Jesus. His poems, novels and literary handbooks are left out as not theology. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 101 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

wjdawson-threshold-manhood: The threshold of manhood, a young man's words to young men (New York, Armstrong, 1889)
wjdawson-church-tomorrow: The church of to-morrow : a series of addresses delivered in America, Canada, and Great Britain (London : J. Clarke, 1892)
wjdawson-endless-choice: The endless choice, and other sermons (London : J. Nisbet, 1897)
wjdawson-life-of-christ: The life of Christ (Philadelphia, G. W. Jacobs & co, 1901)
wjdawson-reproach-of-christ: The reproach of Christ, and other sermons (New York, Chicago, Fleming H. Revell Co, 1903)
wjdawson-evangelistic-note: The evangelistic note (New York ; Chicago : Fleming H. Revell company, 1905)
wjdawson-empire-of-love: The empire of love (New York, Chicago [etc.] Fleming H. Revell company, [190)
wjdawson-divine-challenge: The divine challenge (New York : Hodder & Stoughton : George H. Doran, 1910)
wjdawson-book-of-courage: The book of courage (New York, F. H. Revell, 1911)
wjdawson-man-christ-jesus: The man Christ Jesus; a life of Christ (New York London : The Century co., 1925)

_excluded.wjdawson-literary: Poems, novels (A Prophet in Babylon, The War Eagle and others) and the Makers of English handbooks: not theology
